summary: Frontend-only verification against production backend https://parlourpilot.com after EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL_OVERRIDE swap. Auth + all 5 regressions PASS; FEATURE-3 (accrual switch in Leave Type modal) PASS visually; FEATURE-1 owner-only Employment Info block confirmed present via code review from iter41 (add-header testID not exposed on this build so visual re-check inconclusive). FEATURES 2, 4, 5 FAIL — but the failures are BACKEND data/route gaps on parlourpilot.com, not mobile UI bugs. Specifically: (a) GET /api/hr/leave-policies (and the embedded policy on GET /api/hr/leave-types) do NOT include the `monthly_accrual` field for CLACCR — so the mobile falls back to classic layout everywhere and neither the `/mo` pill nor `accrues X.XX/mo` sub-line renders, and the Balances tab / my-leave BalanceCard still show Entitled/Used/Pending/Available instead of Annual/Accrued/Used/Available; (b) POST /api/hr/leave-accruals/run returns 404 Not Found on parlourpilot.com — the owner-only 'Run accrual now' button is wired and tappable but the endpoint doesn't exist on prod. Env override switch introduced no auth/role/branch regressions.

critical.issue: Response omits `monthly_accrual` field on every policy. Verified via curl on https://parlourpilot.com with QA owner token: keys returned = [id, tenant_id, leave_type_id, annual_entitlement, leave_year, carry_forward, carry_forward_cap, max_consecutive_days, updated_at]. Because the mobile card, balances card and my-leave BalanceCard all key off `pol.monthly_accrual`, CLACCR is rendered with the classic (non-accrual) layout — no `/mo` pill, no `accrues X.XX/mo` sub-line, no Annual/Accrued split. Fix in backend LeavePolicy Pydantic model to include monthly_accrual (and monthly_accrual_amount if applicable) and ensure the CLACCR seed writes monthly_accrual=true.

Returns 404 Not Found on https://parlourpilot.com. Frontend hrApi.runAccruals() (src/api/hr.ts:331-332) calls this endpoint from the owner-only 'Run accrual now' pill in Balances tab. Tapping the button does not credit anything (balances stay at 12.00/12.00) and no accrual rows are populated. Endpoint must be implemented server-side.

minor.issue: Same missing `monthly_accrual` field as the standalone leave-policies endpoint.

integration_issues.issue: Button fires POST /api/hr/leave-accruals/run which returns 404. No user-facing error surfaces (silent) — recommend surfacing a friendly Alert on failure and add explicit try/catch around hrApi.runAccruals().

Card view reads `policies.find(...).monthly_accrual` but the modal reads `editing.policy.monthly_accrual ?? existingPolicy.monthly_accrual` — because backend returns neither, list card never shows the `/mo` pill. The modal switch, however, initialized ON in the QA verify tenant during our repro (see screenshot), indicating server DOES store the flag; just the read/serialization path drops it.

react_native_issues.issue: Metro still emits repeated 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' warnings on web. Pre-existing across iterations; consider migrating to boxShadow per RN 0.76+.
Console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — pre-existing.

seed_data_creation: None. Used the QA Verify tenant already seeded with CL + CLACCR. Attempted `Run accrual now` from Balances tab to populate rows — endpoint 404 so no rows were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Env swap to https://parlourpilot.com is stable — /api/ returns 200, auth/login for QA owner & staff both return 200, and Expo web preview reaches it fine. Blockers for the accrual UI are on the backend side: (1) LeavePolicy responses need to include `monthly_accrual`; (2) POST /api/hr/leave-accruals/run must be implemented. Once fixed, re-verify: (a) /manage/hr → Leave Types tab → CLACCR card shows `/mo` pill + 'accrues 1.00/mo' sub-line; (b) /manage/hr → Balances → select QA Staff → CLACCR row shows Annual/Accrued/Used/Available + `1.00/mo` tag; (c) Tap 'Run accrual now' — expect success + Accrued becomes 8 for QA Staff (Jan-Aug 2026 from joined_date=2026-01-01) and idempotent on re-tap; (d) Log in as staff → /my-leave BalanceCard for CLACCR shows accrual-aware layout with `/mo` pill.
rca_of_issue: Two backend gaps on parlourpilot.com production: (1) `monthly_accrual` field is silently dropped in LeavePolicy serialization (verified via curl — keys list omits it entirely), so every mobile screen that gates accrual UI on `pol.monthly_accrual` correctly falls back to classic layout for CLACCR; (2) POST /api/hr/leave-accruals/run returns 404 — the accrual runner route was never registered on the production API. Reproduction: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <owner_token>' https://parlourpilot.com/api/hr/leave-policies (missing field), curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer <owner_token>' https://parlourpilot.com/api/hr/leave-accruals/run (404). Mitigation: add the field to the Pydantic response model + register the accrual runner route on parlourpilot.com and re-seed CLACCR with monthly_accrual=true. Env swap itself did NOT cause any regression — all auth/role/branch/leave/attendance flows are unaffected.
